title: Aoi round 1: a 3D chibi made the way Kuro round 3 was
question: The first two sheets are ChatGPT pictures; every sheet after them is a render of a real rigged 3D model, and the live 3D link below lets you turn her and watch her idle and walk beside the in-game Eric and Mio and Kuro round 3. Is this Aoi right?

media.caption: ChatGPT pictures. Your verdict on Kuro round 3: "Now lets use this approach for aoi and emi as well". One chat in ChatGPT's image model (openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 on OpenRouter). Step 1 attached these two: her approved portrait and your Mio chibi.

Every take, in order, with your words as written: 1 "make a 3d chibi anime character in the style of the attached image" (a1, a2; a1 kept her dark roots), 2 "Simplify female character a LOT to match the detail level of the other chibi, with open eyes" (b1), 3 "Simpler head model" (c1 raised her hand against her hair, which Meshy would fuse into the head; c2 did not), then your angle prompt (d1 raised the hand again). The image budget for both characters was $3, and Emi's angle takes used the rest, so there was no second angle take. c2 already stands at a three-quarter angle with her head and body facing the same way, so c2 went to Meshy, not d1. Her head is 0.42 of her height in c2 (top of the hair to the chin, over top to soles; Kuro's picked picture was 0.45), so the head-size follow-up wasn't needed. 6 takes, $1.47.

3D renders from here on. Head size on the models: straight-on, flat-colour pictures in the rest pose, each scaled to the same height (the in-game Eric and Mio and Kuro round 3 are the pictures measured for Kuro round 3). Head share of height: Eric 0.46, Mio 0.52 (her buns count), Kuro round 3 0.41, Aoi 0.43. Widest part of the head over the width of the legs: Eric 1.95, Mio 2.33, Kuro round 3 2.20, Aoi 2.11.
Meshy image-to-3D from c2 with Kuro's settings: smart topology (meshy-t2), 1,050 polygons, A-pose, no texture, 5 credits. Meshy's own previews. First roll, kept: 1,111 triangles.

Kuro round 3's fix before the texture pass: our own UV layout with the front of her face as one piece at 3 times the detail of the rest. Kuro's script started the face at a point in the middle of her face; on Aoi that point is on the bang that hangs down to her nose, so it took the bang alone (7 polygons, 2.8 % of the texture). Here the face is the biggest front-facing piece of the head instead (36 polygons, red), which gives the face 17 % of the texture (Kuro's: 14 %). Then Meshy retexture on that mesh with Kuro's settings: styled from c2, keep the UVs, lighting removed, no PBR, 2048 px, 10 credits. Right: the texture Meshy painted; her face came out as one piece.

The textured model: front, her left three-quarter (image right side turned to us), her left side, back, her right three-quarter, face. Same camera and light as Kuro's rounds. Her hands are white-grey: in c2 they are in her jacket pockets, so Meshy had no skin to copy for them.

Face close-ups, then three flat-colour pictures from below the chin, looking for dark marks like the one under Kuro's cheek. No black or dark smudges on her face. There is a faint brownish shadow on her chin below the mouth and a tiny teal dot at the edge of her left cheek (image right). The texture also has a small pink and teal spot on her forehead between the brows, hidden behind the bang that hangs down the middle.
Aoi beside the in-game Meshy Eric and Mio and Kuro round 3 (the same render script and camera), front and her right three-quarter. In the live viewer they all stand at the same height.

Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m, as for Kuro, 5 credits. Stills from the live viewer: rest, idle, walk, walk from the side. The idle and walk are the game's (Mio's approved idle and walk, carried over by bone name). She is not in the game. Meshy credits for Aoi: 20 (shape 5, texture 10, rig 5); the balance is now 412 after Aoi and Emi.
